ui.title: AI Businesses: 13 Ranked from Worst to Best—and Where to Start
ui.description: Thirteen businesses you can start with artificial intelligence, evaluated by INEMA for technical requirements, market opportunity, and durability. Plus a 6-question assessment, offer sheets by industry, and a 90-day plan.
ui.hero_titulo: AI Businesses: from worst to best—and where to start
ui.hero_lead: Thirteen businesses you can start today with AI, ranked from worst to best for building, with INEMA’s scores for technical skills, market opportunity, and durability—and a ladder showing where to enter and how to move up.
ui.hero_alt: AI Businesses banner: from worst to best for getting started
ui.resumo: A new business idea powered by artificial intelligence appears every day, and choosing has become harder than building. This page evaluates thirteen of them with three scores from 1 to 5: how much technical knowledge you need to deliver something people will pay for, how much room there is in the market (more buyers than sellers), and how well the business can last and grow without being swallowed by a platform. The list ranks them from worst to best for building over the long term. That is not the same as the best one to start with: the top-ranked business requires experience no one has on day one, and some businesses near the bottom are great first steps. The rule at the end is simple: at the bottom, you sell what you build, which gets cheaper every month; at the top, you sell your judgment, which becomes more valuable. That is why the second part is a four-step ladder, with a 6-question assessment to find your step, ready-to-use offers for each business, industry examples, and a 90-day plan. The prices in reais are reference ranges for what people charge, not a promise of earnings.
ui.notas_sub: None of the businesses on this list are bad: they all work for someone. The scores show what kind of challenges you will face. The ranking is not the sum of the scores: it combines all three with how much the business pays, how much it depends on you, and whether it takes you to the next step.
ui.n_tec_d: How much knowledge you need to deliver something people will pay for. A high score means it is harder.
ui.n_mer_d: Whether more people want to buy than are selling today. A high score means more opportunity.
ui.n_dur_d: Whether it can become a business that stands for years without being swallowed by a platform. A high score means it is more solid.
ui.rapido_sub: From 13th (worst business to build) to 1st (best). Tap a business to see its full profile.
ui.kpi: The number you track with the client
ui.rel_titulo: INEMA projects and courses to get started

ui.regra_titulo: At the bottom, you sell what you build. At the top, your judgment.
ui.regra_texto: Building a website, automation, or app gets cheaper every month because AI does much of the work. Diagnosing the right problem, persuading a team to change, and being accountable for the result remain expensive because they depend on you. Starting at the bottom is not a mistake: that is where you gain experience and your first clients. The mistake is staying there.

ui.escada_desc: A 6-question assessment that points you to a starter AI business, ready-to-use offers for each step, examples by industry (clinic, accounting, real estate, law, restaurant), and a 90-day plan.

ui.degraus_sub: The higher you go, the less you sell building hours and the more you sell diagnosis and accountability. The clients at the lower step are the same ones who will buy at the higher step.

ui.setores_sub: Clients do not buy "AI." They buy fewer missed calls, more appointments booked, and fewer hours spent typing. Choose an industry to see the offer for each step.

ui.plano_sub: The plan works for any step. What changes is the offer you bring.
ui.foco_titulo: Choose one and stick with it
ui.foco_texto: People who succeed rarely chose the perfect business at the perfect time. They chose one, stuck with it long enough, and did not switch niches every three weeks. Use the assessment to decide, not to procrastinate.

ui.aviso: Prices are reference ranges for what people charge in Brazil (Brazil) in 2026, not a promise of earnings. Results depend on the offer, industry, execution, and time.
ui.degrau_nota: The step is a different scale: it shows how much proof and trust you need to sell that business. That is why the list ranking and the ladder order are not the same—the ladder is where you discover where to enter.
ui.teste_topo: You are already at the highest step: the next move is to serve more companies or add the other business at the top.

negocios.curta: The most talked about and the hardest to start: building the app has become easy; getting people to pay every month has not.
texto: You build software with AI and charge a subscription for people to use it. The potential is huge, it can grow with a small team, and that is why it appears in more success videos than any other business.

The problem is that building has become the cheap part. It has never been easier to launch an app, and there have never been so many competing for the same attention. The real business is getting discovered, convincing people to pay, and keeping them from canceling. As usage grows, security and infrastructure costs catch up with you. And an app that is just a thin layer over a model dies with the next platform update.
negocios.preco: R$ 29 to R$ 299 per month per client; you need hundreds of clients to make a living from it.
negocios.para_quem: People who already have an audience, a service business, or enough cash to go months without revenue.
negocios.armadilha: Building before you have buyers. Most SaaS businesses that grow started as a service that was already selling.
comecar: Sell the solution as a done-for-you service to 3 clients
Write down what repeats across all of them
Only then turn the repeated part into an app
negocios.oferta: I solve [task] for [type of company] for a monthly fee, with nothing for you to install.

rel.nome: Immersion: From Zero to an AI App
rel.d: From prototype to AI product, step by step.
Agents that test whether an idea has buyers before you build it.

negocios.curta: Cheap to start and good for learning, but views alone do not pay the bills.
texto: A YouTube, TikTok, or Instagram account where AI helps create the content and you do not appear. The startup cost is almost zero, and you can test different formats quickly.

The money does not come from views. It comes from people who want to reach that audience: sponsors, your own product, or a paid community. Platforms do not monetize mass-produced repetitive content, and viral content without a defined audience does not attract anyone willing to pay. First think about who is watching and who would pay to reach them.
negocios.preco: Sponsorships from R$ 300 to R$ 5,000 per post when the audience is engaged and focused on a niche.
negocios.para_quem: People who want to learn to produce with AI and are willing to build an audience for months before earning money.
negocios.armadilha: Choosing a topic based on what goes viral instead of who would pay to reach that audience. And the platform can change its rules overnight.
comecar: Choose a specific topic with clear advertisers (finance, health, tools)
Post 1 video a day for 30 days
List 10 brands that advertise in that niche
negocios.oferta: My channel reaches [audience] every day; your product gets in front of them for [price].
negocios.kpi: Niche followers and sponsorship value per post

rel.d: 16:9 video without a camera or avatar, with locally generated voice.
Find what goes viral in your niche and create your own version.

negocios.curta: The best place for a beginner to start: fast, visual, and easy to show. But it has a low ceiling.
texto: You build websites for small businesses with AI tools in an afternoon instead of weeks. You can put together a demo of the client’s own website before speaking with them, which changes the conversation: they see it finished before paying.

Agencies still charge a lot for the old way, so you can come in at a lower price and deliver faster. The limit is that AI website builders cost only a few dozen reais a month, and the client will find out. Use this to build momentum, a portfolio, and your first clients, then move up.
negocios.preco: R$ 1,500 to R$ 5,000 per website, plus R$ 100 to R$ 300 a month for maintenance.
negocios.para_quem: A complete beginner who wants a first client quickly and something visual to show.
negocios.armadilha: Selling only websites. It is hard to make more than a few thousand reais a month.
comecar: Choose 10 local businesses with a bad website or no website
Build a demo for 3 of them in 20 minutes each
Send the link and offer to publish it
negocios.oferta: I made a new version of your website; if you like it, I can publish it this week.
negocios.kpi: Inbound contacts through the website per month

rel.d: Turn references into a style, images, and a website ready to show.
Help the client’s website appear on Google and in AI search results.

negocios.curta: Great for getting into a company and earning trust; hard to tie to a financial result.
texto: You bring the company’s agents, automations, tools, and team knowledge together in one place: an assistant that knows the documents and processes and answers in the channel the company already uses.

It is an excellent entry point because once the client trusts you, they will buy bigger projects. The weak point is measurement. Every offer needs a number the owner tracks (sales, hours, support interactions), and a generic hub does not move a clear number. It also only works if the owner already believes in AI; otherwise, the team does not change its habits and you have no case study.
negocios.preco: R$ 5,000 to R$ 20,000 for setup, plus R$ 800 to R$ 3,000 per month.
negocios.para_quem: People who already build AI assistants and automations and have access to tech-friendly business owners.
negocios.armadilha: Selling the hub without a number tied to it. Without measured results, you get no referrals.
comecar: Choose a process with a clear number (for example, response time)
Build the hub only for that process
Measure before and after for 2 weeks
negocios.oferta: I put everything your team asks into one assistant, and we measure how much response time drops.
negocios.kpi: Hours saved per week across the team

rel.d: A foundation for running the company’s assistants in one place.
An assistant that works with the office’s files.

negocios.curta: It is the SEO of the ChatGPT era: companies already pay for it, and it is still early—but you need to know how to prove results.
texto: You work to get the client’s brand recommended when someone asks ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, or Perplexity a question. It is an extension of SEO (the work of getting a website to appear on Google), a market that has existed for decades and that companies know they need to pay for.

People who already do SEO have a huge advantage because they know how to measure and show results. Without that foundation, it is hard to prove the change came from your work. And the rules for which brands appear in answers can change at any time.
negocios.preco: R$ 2,000 to R$ 6,000 per month per client.
negocios.para_quem: People who already work in SEO, content, or digital marketing.
negocios.armadilha: Promising a spot in an AI answer. Promise the work and show measured progress.
comecar: Ask 3 AI tools 20 questions about the client’s industry and note which brands appear
Fix the website, data, and pages the AI reads
Repeat the 20 questions after 30 days
negocios.oferta: Today AI recommends your competitor when people ask about [service]. I work to change that and show you the measurements every month.
negocios.kpi: How many of the 20 questions mention the brand

rel.d: An SEO + GEO method for Google, Bing, and AI search.
Technical audit and AI search optimization with Claude Code.

negocios.curta: Demand keeps growing, but ready-made workflows have become a commodity. The value is in finding the bottleneck.
texto: You connect AI to the systems the company already uses: customer relationship management (CRM), email, spreadsheets, invoices, and WhatsApp. It is where many people started, and it is still where service requests are most common.

But building automations is getting easier, and many companies already hire someone internally to do it. A one-off workflow is worth little. What matters is finding the most expensive bottleneck, tying the fix to a business result, and charging for that result—and that is already the consulting step.
negocios.preco: R$ 1,500 to R$ 6,000 per workflow; more when priced by results.
negocios.para_quem: People who enjoy logic and tools and want steady demand for their services.
negocios.armadilha: Selling one-off workflows and competing on price with thousands of people.
comecar: Ask the client which task takes the team the most time
Automate only that task and measure before and after
Use the result to sell a fix for the next bottleneck
negocios.oferta: Your team spends [X] hours a week on [task]. I automate it and show you the hours returned to the team.
negocios.kpi: Hours returned to the team per week

rel.d: Build automations that connect your systems, step by step.
Find where the business is losing money and show the amount in reais.

negocios.curta: You get paid to teach and leave the room as the company’s “AI person.”
texto: You teach a company’s team to use AI in their own work, using the company’s real cases. At many companies, people use AI on their own without training, and the owner knows it.

The biggest payoff comes afterward. In the room, you see all the company’s problems and earn trust right away. A bigger project often follows a workshop. Teaching is a skill you can practice, and you need to master the tools you teach.
negocios.preco: R$ 3,000 for a half-day to R$ 15,000 for a full day with a large group.
negocios.para_quem: People who enjoy explaining, speak well in public, and already use AI in their own work.
negocios.armadilha: A generic “ChatGPT for beginners” workshop. Bring the company’s real cases, or nobody will use it the next day.
comecar: Put together a 3-hour workshop with 5 real use cases for one industry
Run the first one free or at a low price in exchange for a testimonial
Always finish with a diagnosis of what can be automated
negocios.oferta: In 3 hours, your team will leave using AI for [5 tasks in your industry], with materials to keep going.
negocios.kpi: People using AI at work 30 days later

rel.d: Prepare people and companies to adopt AI thoughtfully.
Turn what you know into a method you can teach.

negocios.nome: AI receptionist and customer service agent
negocios.curta: AI handles WhatsApp, phone, and website, books appointments, and hands off to a human. In Brazil, WhatsApp moves this business up the list.
texto: AI answers messages, phone calls, and website chats, answers questions, books appointments, and calls in a person when needed. The return is easy to explain: the owner only has to count how many messages and calls went unanswered last month—and for a clinic, repair shop, or office, each one could be a lost client.

In Brazil, where almost everything goes through WhatsApp, the pain is even more obvious. The risk is durability: the scheduling and customer service systems these businesses already pay for are adding their own AI. The winners will be people who know the industry and take care of setup, rules, and follow-up.
negocios.preco: R$ 2,000 to R$ 8,000 for setup, plus R$ 500 to R$ 2,000 per month.
negocios.para_quem: People who want recurring service revenue and results that are easy to show the owner.
negocios.armadilha: Selling the same generic AI to everyone: the system the client already uses will offer the same thing for less. Also, health data is sensitive in clinics: use a tool with a data protection agreement and route clinical questions to a person.
comecar: Choose an industry (clinic, repair shop, salon)
Build the demo around real questions from that industry
Show the owner how many messages went unanswered last month
negocios.oferta: Your clinic answers every message, even at 10 p.m.: the AI books appointments and calls you when needed.
negocios.kpi: Messages and calls answered, and appointments booked

rel.d: AI customer service for clinics: scheduling, questions, and follow-up.
WhatsApp leads are routed immediately to an available team member.
Gym: plans, available classes, and check-in through WhatsApp.

negocios.curta: Ads, videos, and carousels for brands. Anyone can press “generate”; clients pay for taste and results.
texto: You produce ads, commercials, carousels, and video edits for brands with AI. One person can now do what used to require a team and expensive equipment.

The other side is that anyone can press the generate button, including inside ad platforms, and the price per asset is falling. Clients pay for taste, for knowing which model works for which audience, and for using each ad’s numbers to make the next one better. If your ads sell, the client stays.
negocios.preco: R$ 2,000 to R$ 8,000 per month per brand, in a package of assets.
negocios.para_quem: People with an eye for visuals who enjoy video and want to track ad results.
negocios.armadilha: Selling attractive assets one at a time. Sell a monthly package tied to campaign results.
comecar: Recreate 3 ads from a brand you admire
Offer a trial package of 10 assets
Show the result of each asset and improve the next one
negocios.oferta: Every month, you get [N] new ads, and I replace the ones that do not sell with ones that do.
negocios.kpi: Cost per sale or lead from campaigns

rel.d: Turn a script into carousels and stories ready to publish.
Create video with code and locally generated voice, without a paid generator.
Pricing, packages, and a portfolio for selling production services.

negocios.curta: The clearest result on the list: more leads, more sales. When leads turn into sales, clients are unlikely to cancel.
texto: You use AI to find companies and people showing buying signals (a job opening, a new store, an expansion), fill in their contact details, personalize your outreach, and test far more messages than a human team could. You deliver meetings or genuinely interested leads to the client.

It is the stickiest business: if you send clients to a business and they make money from them, they are unlikely to cancel. The number is the easiest to measure. The condition is tough: you need to generate your own clients first, or nobody will believe you can generate theirs. Agencies that already do prospecting and add AI have a head start.
negocios.preco: R$ 3,000 to R$ 10,000 per month, or a fee per meeting booked.
negocios.para_quem: People who enjoy sales, numbers, and testing, and are willing to prove the method on themselves.
negocios.armadilha: Mass outreach without targeting: it sends the client’s email and WhatsApp messages to spam and damages their reputation. Contact only through public business channels, say who you are, offer an opt-out, and do not buy contact lists (LGPD).
comecar: Use your own prospecting to get your first 3 clients
Choose an industry and a buying signal (job opening, new store, expansion)
Offer 30 days of paid work, charging per meeting booked
negocios.oferta: I find meetings with [type of client] for your calendar, and you pay for the ones that happen.
negocios.kpi: Meetings booked and sales closed per month

rel.d: Find people showing buying signals and reach out at the right time.
Every incoming lead gets an immediate response.

negocios.curta: The most durable of all: people who trust you will follow you when the tools change. But it takes years.
texto: Courses, community, newsletters, and videos, preferably with your face and voice. You need to be involved in the subject every day to teach it, or at least be comfortable on camera. Competition is growing, but so is the audience that wants to learn.

It is the most durable business because people invest in you, not a tool: when the technology changes, you change with it, and they stay. The problem is speed. Building an audience takes years, and trust comes from proof. That is why the usual path is to do services and consulting first, then use your brand to launch the other businesses.
negocios.preco: From individual courses to a community subscription; it depends on the audience’s size and trust.
negocios.para_quem: People with experience to share who enjoy teaching and can handle building gradually.
negocios.armadilha: Starting with the brand without proof. First results, then trust, then audience.
comecar: Document one real case you solved every week
Post on the same channel, on the same day, for 90 days
Bring the people who respond into your own list or group
negocios.oferta: Every week, I show how to solve [problem] with AI, using real cases.
negocios.kpi: People on your list or in your community

rel.d: Organize what you know into a named method.
Publish consistently without spending all day on design.

negocios.curta: You are the doctor: you understand how the company works, find the bottleneck, and prescribe where AI can save the most.
texto: You go into a company, understand the process, find the bottleneck, and identify where AI can save the most time or money. Fixes get cheaper every month; the diagnosis remains valuable. There is also the human side that no AI can solve: persuading the team, setting usage rules, and helping people change their habits.

Implementing AI properly in a company takes work, and most of the value lies in that implementation. Consulting pays faster than education and opens the door to automation, customer service, and training projects.
negocios.preco: A diagnostic engagement costs R$ 3,000 to R$ 30,000, plus implementation.
negocios.para_quem: People who understand business, ask good questions, and have already delivered a few AI projects.
negocios.armadilha: Delivering a polished report and leaving. Clients pay for change, not the PDF.
comecar: Offer a one-day diagnostic at a fixed price
Deliver 3 opportunities with estimated savings in reais
Propose implementing the first one with a measured target
negocios.oferta: In one week, I will show you where AI can save your company the most money, in reais, and implement the first solution.
negocios.kpi: Reais saved or earned per month after implementation

rel.d: Trains AI consultants to work with small businesses.

rel.nome: AI Consulting: From Diagnosis to Delivery
rel.d: Diagnosis, solution design, pricing, delivery, and growth.
A kit for bringing AI to small and medium-sized businesses.

negocios.curta: The top: take responsibility for one company’s AI strategy, or several companies’ strategies at once.
texto: There are two equally good paths. Become the AI lead at the company where you already work and take responsibility for its strategy and results. Or work as a fractional director, serving a few companies at the same time for a few hours each week. This is often the natural next step for someone who has done consulting.

More companies want someone accountable for AI, and people who combine AI knowledge with business insight tend to be more valued. It requires knowing enough to avoid being caught off guard and carrying yourself like an executive. The more AI advances, the more valuable the person who decides how to use it becomes.
negocios.preco: Fractional: R$ 8,000 to R$ 25,000 per month per company. In-house: executive salary.
negocios.para_quem: People with management or consulting experience and the trust of owners and executives.
negocios.armadilha: Wanting the title without proof. It comes after measured results at other companies.
comecar: Choose 1 company where you already have trust
Propose 90 days with 3 AI-related business goals
Give the leadership team a monthly results report
negocios.oferta: I take care of your company’s AI a few hours a week: strategy, tools, team, and results.

rel.d: Coordinate multiple agents and teams on one screen.
Agents that discover and validate business opportunities.

degraus.d: Visual things that are quick to show. Good for gaining experience and your first clients; prices fall every year.
Customer service, automation, creative assets, AI search, and apps. Recurring revenue and an easy-to-show number, but it takes more technical skill or cash.
Workshops, consulting, and lead generation. Pays better and opens the door to larger projects.
AI director and personal brand. Slower to reach, harder to replace.

plano.d: Choose a business and an industry. Build the demo using the client’s public information (website, social media, menu) or sample data, never private data without permission.
